rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: PyDESeq2 negative-binomial Wald testing with ~condition, control set as the explicit reference level, no spurious batch or pairing terms for a single-batch unpaired 6v6, and a sensitivity refit excluding sample_01 rather than a reflexive drop. QC is thorough and dataset-specific — library sizes, detected genes, size factors, PCA and correlation heatmaps, and a numeric PC1/PC2-vs-log-depth correlation with a pre-stated keep/drop rule — and the low-count filter (sum >= 10, expressed in >= 3 samples) is minimal, justified, and reported as the tested universe. Normalization stays inside the model with raw integer counts and median-of-ratios size factors, and significance is BH padj < 0.05 with apeglm/ashr shrinkage for ranking; the added |log2FC| >= 1 subset is reported alongside rather than substituted, a very minor blemish. Enrichment is gseapy prerank on the full ranked list with the metric stated, a fixed seed, >= 1000 permutations, sets restricted to the tested universe, and an ORA cross-check with an explicit background; only the MSigDB release version is left unnamed (resolved at run time) and the size window is 10-500 rather than 15-500. Reporting names package versions, design, thresholds, gene counts, and honest caveats about n=6 and the 12,000-gene pre-filter.
